_workflow: nano-banana-pro (CREF → image scène) → Kling 3.0/V2.1 (start_image → animation) → LatentSync → Shotstack BPM-cut → MP4
_prompt_rules: Workflow 2 étapes : nano-banana-pro construit la scène (imagePrompt 7-couches + CREF identité) → Kling anime (motionPrompt = mouvement uniquement)
Kling ne réinterprète JAMAIS — start_image = frame nano-banana-pro
imagePrompt : structure 7-couches MASTER-PROMPT, 120-200 mots, camera first, end-state, grade DP référencé
motionPrompt : 30-60 mots, mouvement caméra FIRST, qualités Laban, end-state, pas de redescription de la scène
Palette identitaire : gold, deep burgundy, cream concrete, pitch black, cold blue
Anti-patterns exclus : no 'ultra-detailed', no '8K', no 'stunning', no 'beautiful'

_cref._note: Passé comme reference_image à nano-banana-pro — maintien identité 90%+. L'artiste est mis en scène dans de NOUVELLES situations (pas animation de la photo source).

requests._note: Le monde avant d'être nommé. La cage invisible.
requests.prompt:
OPENING WIDE SHOT (0-4s): Locked overhead looking down — twenty people walking fast, heads bowed to phones. Cold blue screen glow upward on every chin. Wet asphalt mirrors LED streetlights as broken white columns. One CCTV dome on a lamppost rotates slowly. Camera: locked overhead static.
CUT TO (4-7s): Slow crane down arriving at eye level — we descend among them. They still do not look up. Cold. Phone screens. Fog at ankle level. Camera: slow crane down arriving at walking-level eye height.
CLOSE ON (7-10s): Locked at street level — close on a single pair of feet walking, phone screen reflected in the wet pavement. The rest: blurred crowd. Camera: low angle locked static. Grade: Bradford Young — Arrival. Near-monochrome. Screen glow is the only warmth. The system observes without being seen. 4K HDR, 16:9.
requests.motionPrompt: Overhead static then slow crane down arriving at street level, ease out. Final shot: low angle on pavement reflection.

requests._note: Le regard du système. Un seul dôme CCTV. Réaliste et oppressant.
requests.prompt: Locked macro arriving at lens-fill close-up — static frame. Single black CCTV dome camera, rain-soaked concrete wall. The convex fisheye lens fills two-thirds of the frame. Rain beads on the glass — each drop magnified, distorting what lies behind. Camera housing rotates slowly left on its ball mount — bound flow, mechanical. Key: cold blue ambient, slight underexposure. No warmth. Signature: in the fisheye reflection, a miniature distorted street scene — people walking, unaware. Grade: Hoyte van Hoytema — Dunkirk. Cold steel blue, hard grey. The eye that never closes never needs to follow you. 4K HDR, 16:9, 5s.
requests.motionPrompt: Locked static macro. Camera does not move. Dome rotates slowly left. Rain drops bead on lens.

requests.imagePrompt: Generate a cinematic wide shot of a deserted underground metro corridor at 2 AM. A Black man with long thick dreadlocks, short grey beard, brown fitted cap, grey-blue hoodie, black cargo pants walks slowly away from camera in the center of the corridor. The tunnel extends ahead of him — no visible end. Overhead fluorescent tubes line the ceiling at intervals, one flickering. His shadow stretches long on the wet grey concrete behind him. Phi grid: figure centered, corridor lines receding to a vanishing point at upper center. Key light: cold white fluorescent overhead, one tube warmer amber catching the cap. Deep lateral shadows on both walls. Signature: the flickering tube is behind him, already passed. Palette: cold grey-blue corridor, warm amber cap, deep shadow. Grade: Roger Deakins — Blade Runner 2049. Deep blue-green shadows, warm amber skin, pale gold on cap. Shot on ARRI Alexa Mini LF, Zeiss Supreme Prime 21mm T1.5, T2.0. Shallow depth — subject sharp, tunnel recedes soft. Moving forward but the tunnel gives nothing back. 4K, 16:9.
requests.motionPrompt:
OPENING WIDE SHOT (0-4s): Slow push-in from wide arriving at medium shot — figure in tunnel, camera advances at his pace. Sustained drift. Camera: slow push-in arriving at medium.
CUT TO (4-7s): Medium close-up. Camera arrives at eye level — his face becomes visible in the amber tube light. His jaw is set. Camera: static with natural breathing.
CLOSE ON (7-10s): Slow pull back arriving at wide again — tunnel recedes, he grows smaller. The corridor gives nothing. Camera: slow pull-back arriving at wide.

Phi grid: left fist at left intersection. Grade: Roger Deakins — Blade Runner 2049. Red and cold blue opposition, skin warmth between them. The body holds what the voice has not yet said. 4K HDR, 16:9, 5s.
requests.motionPrompt: Locked static macro. Fists clench then slowly open, fingers uncurl one by one. Slow motion 50%. No camera movement.

requests.imagePrompt: Generate a cinematic wide shot of a deserted circular concrete plaza at night. A Black man with long thick dreadlocks, short grey beard, dark cap stands alone at the exact geometric center. Identical brutalist apartment blocks surround him on all sides — most windows dark except two. He faces the camera directly. Expression: knowing, still, slightly ironic. He does not move. Centered symmetry composition: the figure at dead center, blocks framing him on all four sides. Horizon at 0.618 from top. Key light: single tall sodium lamp above — warm gold circle on ground, cold dark periphery. Signature: his shadow points perfectly toward camera — a sundial at night. Palette: cold steel blue sky, warm sodium gold ground circle, dark concrete blocks. Grade: Hoyte van Hoytema — Dunkirk. Cold steel blue overall, warm sodium accent on him alone. Shot on ARRI Alexa 35, ARRI Signature Prime 47mm T1.8. Shallow field — subject sharp, building edges fall off. Freedom designed by someone else. 4K, 16:9.
requests.motionPrompt:

CUT TO (4-7s): Medium close-up. His face fills more of the frame. Expression: knowing, still. Sodium light on his cap. Camera: locked static, slight breathing.
CLOSE ON (7-10s): Extreme close-up — eyes direct to camera. The geometry of the plaza: one face in a designed space. Camera: slow push-in arriving at tight portrait.

requests.imagePrompt: Generate a cinematic portrait of a Black man with long thick dreadlocks, short grey beard, brown fitted cap, grey-blue hoodie standing at a city bus stop at night. Behind him: a full advertising panel wall covered entirely with the same face repeated — a politician or celebrity, same image 16 times in a 4x4 grid. He is the only real, unrepeated face in the frame. Expression: calm, recognizing the absurdity. Phi grid: his face at right intersection, poster faces filling left two-thirds. Key light: cold fluorescent bus shelter lamp above — blue-green ambient. His skin warm by contrast against the cold field. Signature: the poster face and his face are at exactly the same eye level — perfectly aligned horizontally. Palette: cold blue-green ambient, warm skin tone, dark blue bus shelter. Grade: Bradford Young — Arrival. Near-monochrome, diffuse. Only skin tone retains warmth. Shot on ARRI Alexa Mini LF, Zeiss Supreme Prime 29mm T2.0. Medium shallow depth — his face sharp, poster wall sharp, bus shelter falls soft. In a world of copies, originality is suspicious. 4K, 16:9.
requests.motionPrompt:
OPENING SHOT (0-3s): Wide — posters fill the background, he stands in the right third. Cold fluorescent. Camera: locked static, natural breathing.
CUT TO (3-7s): Slow rack focus — poster faces blur, his face sharpens into tight portrait. The 16 identical faces dissolve into one real one. Camera: slow rack focus arriving at tight portrait on his face.
CLOSE ON (7-10s): Locked tight on his face. He sees it. The bus arrives behind him: a blur of light. He does not move. Camera: locked static.
